reviews.text: We had a wonderful experience with a construction and completion of our outdoor kitchen. Recommendations were made on the best equipment and materials that were within our price range. The work was done quickly. We couldn’t be happier. The construction was superior, and it was the icing on the cake for the landscaping we had done previously. I have included one before picture.
reviews.author: Sherry Hampton

reviews.text: CTX built the most beautiful patio for us! They were AMAZING to work with and their pricing was great. We HIGHLY recommend them!
reviews.author: Jill Wheeler

reviews.text: From design to delivery, it was a good experience and we love the final product. We didn't know much about building a pool and we didn't have to. They listened to our wants during design, gave us great choices to pick from, suggested options we didn't know existed and gave us a pool that we love.
reviews.author: rebecca Quigley

reviews.text: We had an exceptional experience with CTX Pool and Patio during the construction of our new Pool House. Greg and Mickey made the process incredibly smooth, even when we made several changes during the design and construction phases. Overall, the project remained within our budget, was completed on time, and we now have a beautiful Pool House that perfectly complements our home. We are very happy with the final outcome. Thank you so much!
reviews.author: Dennis Frisbee

reviews.text:
We had the best experience with Charred. They were so incredibly easy to work with and produced a great end product!  They were able to match the brick perfectly, design exactly what I was looking for, and communicate and respond quickly anytime I had a question.
I couldn’t recommend them enough!
reviews.author: Kendel Richards

reviews.text: Couldn’t be happier with the entire experience with CTX. As first time pool builders and owners, Mickey and his entire crew were extremely knowledgeable and patient as we asked all of the questions. When we reached out to their referrals, two of them ended up being our neighbors! CTX walked us through the entire process, from design to permits to construction letting us know what to expect day by day. The team is always very responsive and professional. During the build, one of the sub contractors did not meet CTX expectations and CTX had them redo their work to meet CTX standards - without us even seeing the issue or mentioning it. Couldn’t be happier with this experience.
reviews.author: J G

reviews.text:
Highly recommend Mickey and his team. They did a complete tear down and rebuild of our pool and decking and we couldn't be happier.

Excellent communication from the team throughout the entire process. 10 out of 10 stars

I'd hire them again tomorrow.
reviews.author: Chris White

reviews.text: Mickey completed a major outdoor renovation that included building a pool/spa, building a storage building, installing a greenhouse, expanding the existing covered patio and installing an outdoor kitchen. Visitors can't tell the difference between the original patio and the extension.  The work is great. I highly recommend CTO.
reviews.author: John Gillespie

data.summary: Reviews appear overwhelmingly authentic and positive. The content is detailed, specific, and varied. The minor clustering of two recent reviews is not a strong fake signal given the overall high-quality content and lack of any negative patterns. This is consistent with a quality contractor with satisfied customers.
fake_signals: Two 5-star reviews posted within one day of each other (5 and 6 days ago)
All provided reviews are 5-star with no critical feedback
authentic_signals: Specific project details (outdoor kitchen, patio, pool house, pool)
Mention of specific staff names (Greg, Mickey)
Mention of process (design, budget, changes, communication)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Ratings are highly consistent across Google and Yelp. No BBB or Glassdoor presence is not unusual for a smaller contractor.
